description: Defines a data structure for gateway setup payload and provides methods to decode raw strings into this payload, supporting JSON and Base64 encoded formats.

classes.name: GatewaySetupPayload
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the payload for gateway setup, including optional fields for URL, host, port, TLS, and tokens.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a raw string into a GatewaySetupPayload by attempting JSON decoding directly or via Base64 decoding.

methods.name: decodeFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a GatewaySetupPayload object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Payload
methods.description: Converts a Base64-encoded string into a decoded UTF-8 string.
